expected.subject: Tom, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi Tom,

Great to know you connected with the Legora team recently.

Firms like Hengeler Mueller are already using Legora to cut contract review time by around 60%.

If useful, grab a 25-minute walkthrough here: [CALENDLY_LINK].

William
Legora

notes: Hengeler Mueller is itself a known Legora-adjacent firm, 330 lawyers, DE. SMB+ demo CTA. Event leads go cold fast — prioritise.
